widget_mechanic: Row of clickable chips labelled 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+, etc. for bedroom/bathroom-style attributes. Agent must click the chip matching '≥ N', not the chip for N-1 or N+1.
product_type: homes for sale in Tacoma, WA

source_inspiration.instruction: I'm looking for homes for sale in Tacoma, WA that have 3 bedrooms, 2 or more bathrooms, and are under $500k. Can you show me some options?
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [2.1] Output contradiction: The agent stated it would enable “Use exact match” because results were broader than requested, but at that time the UI evidence indicates the bedroom setting was still “3+” and exact match was not yet enabled (allowing non-3-bedroom listings).
